## The Clean Energy Workforce Challenge

The Inflation Reduction Act and global climate commitments are driving unprecedented investment in renewable energy. The sector needs 1.4 million new workers by 2030 — and the pipeline is insufficient.

### Key Roles in Clean Energy

| Role | Sector | Skills | Salary |
|---|---|---|---|
| Solar Installation Technician | Solar | Electrical, roofing, safety | $40K-$65K |
| Wind Turbine Technician | Wind | Mechanical, electrical, heights | $50K-$75K |
| Energy Storage Engineer | Battery/Storage | Chemical engineering, power systems | $100K-$160K |
| Grid Integration Specialist | Utilities | Power systems, SCADA, regulation | $90K-$140K |
| Sustainability Manager | Cross-sector | Carbon accounting, ESG reporting | $80K-$130K |
| Clean Energy Project Manager | Cross-sector | Project management, permitting, finance | $90K-$140K |
| VP Business Development | Developer | Origination, PPA negotiation, market analysis | $150K-$250K |

### Sourcing Strategies

Oil & Gas Transition : Many skills transfer from fossil fuels to renewables:

- Drilling engineers → geothermal
- Pipeline engineers → hydrogen infrastructure
- Offshore workers → offshore wind
- Safety professionals → cross-sector

Have questions about your hiring strategy?

Book a free 30-minute consultation with our team. No commitment, just practical advice.

Military Veterans : DOE's Solar Ready Vets and similar programs train transitioning service members.

Trade Schools : Electrical and mechanical trade programs are adding renewable energy modules.

STEM Graduates : Environmental science, engineering, and chemistry programs produce clean energy candidates.

### The Mission Advantage

Clean energy companies have a powerful hiring advantage: mission. Survey data shows:

- 76% of millennials consider environmental impact when choosing employers
- Candidates accept 10-15% lower compensation for mission-aligned roles
- Retention rates are 20% higher at mission-driven organizations

### Compensation Evolution

Clean energy compensation is rising rapidly as the sector matures:

- Solar installer: +25% since 2023
- Energy storage engineer: +30% since 2023
- Sustainability manager: +20% since 2023
- Project developer: +15% since 2023

### Building Your Clean Energy Team

- Start with project management and technical leads
- Hire installation/field technicians
- Add business development and finance
- Scale operations and maintenance teams
- Build corporate functions (HR, legal, marketing)
